Summary: According to the sources, DeepSeek-V3.1 is a hybrid model released by DeepSeek in August 2025, featuring a total of 671 billion parameters with 37 billion activated for each token, and supporting context lengths up to 128K. It combines the strengths of V3 and R1 into a single model. Another source mentions DeepSeek-V3.1 as a 685-billion-parameter model, an increase from its 671B predecessor, with a 128,000-token context window. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on the exact total parameters of DeepSeek-V3.1.
